protocol_claims.claim: Coordinate input/output grid is [B,128,12,2]; channels [B,128,12,5] regroup into [B,32,12,20] then [B,384,96], and decode through [B,384,8] back to the coordinate grid.
protocol_claims.limits: Preserves joint-index slots and timestamp order, not raw data values or anatomical correctness of corrupted names. B counts endpoint rows, not independent people.

protocol_claims.claim: All token slots persist; artificial hiding zeroes xy/confidence/usability while retaining positional/time identifiers; natural missingness keeps safe xy and can retain finite native confidence.
protocol_claims.limits: Availability masking does not delete time/joint slots or prove successful imputation.

protocol_claims.claim: Canonical people inherit train/development/locked-confirmation assignments before derived variants; duplicate motion hashes cannot cross known identities/splits; windows and variants retain provenance.
protocol_claims.limits: Relies on audited known identities; does not exclude unknown aliases or prior upstream estimator exposure. Full original arrays are not in the compact packet.

protocol_claims.claim: Training and calibration losses select training-person pairs; development references may be read during ordinary bundle validation; repair validates a lazy training-only view.
protocol_claims.limits: Do not claim development references are never opened. Later design choices reuse development outcomes, so loss separation does not imply untouched evaluation.

protocol_claims.claim: Completed training uses112people,692motions,1645windows and315840endpointrecords; development uses14people,155windows,55800records; leading record counts differ because held conditions are excluded in fitting.
protocol_claims.limits: Record counts remain nested within people; the larger candidate cohort plan is not the admitted cohort.

protocol_claims.claim: H0 mean comparator-minus-candidate gain≤0 versus gain>0 retrospectively formalizes the three recorded primary comparisons; original two-sided intervals and no-margin status are retained.
protocol_claims.limits: No explicit original notebook H0/H1 was found; no preregistration, new one-sided test, null acceptance, equivalence, or response noninferiority is asserted.

scope: Explanatory protocol and three separately reported declared primary estimates; no new data, fitting, tests, pooled effect, or confirmation outcomes.
gain_definition: Comparator error minus candidate error; positive favors the named candidate.
interval_definition: First two rows: original crossed person/seed 95% intervals. Third row: original person-averaged Student-t 95% interval conditional on three fitted seeds; ViTPose waveform outcome, not response error.
display: Three decimal places only for visible labels; all plotted positions and saved selections use the original unrounded values.
protocol_limits: B counts endpoint rows, not people. Missing slots retained does not establish correct imputation. Training-only fitting/calibration does not assert development data were never read for bundle validation. No locked-cohort count or result is plotted.
portability: Run with --from-audit using this JSON, the script, and paper_style.py; no original comparison files or machine-specific ledgers required.
